column1:
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle
to Pottuvil via Hambantota during the evening or night.

Winds will be North-easterly in the sea areas from Kankasanthurai to Hambantota via Batticaloa. Winds
will be North-westerly or variable in the other sea areas around the island. Wind speed will be (20-40)
kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
